title: ListSessionsResponse
description: List of active SQL sessions across all cluster nodes.

errors.description: Errors encountered while collecting session data from individual nodes. Sessions from healthy nodes are still returned.

node_id.description: Node ID that returned an error.

next.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of session results.

Session.description: An active SQL session on the CockroachDB cluster, representing a connection from a client application.

node_id.description: Node ID where this session is being served.

application_name.description: Application name reported by the SQL client driver.

start.description: Timestamp when the session was established.

last_active_query.description: Most recently executed SQL query in this session.

alloc_bytes.description: Memory allocated by this session in bytes.

max_alloc_bytes.description: Peak memory allocation for this session in bytes.

active_queries.description: Currently executing queries within this session.

active_txn.description: Currently active transaction within this session, if any.
